en: Multi-view color postcard showing different scenes of a lakeside town surrounded by mountains. Images include a waterfront with a sailing boat, palm trees, a clock tower near a building labeled 'Hotel Sole', aerial and promenade views of the town along the lake, and a fortified, ivy-covered building by the water. A red band across the center carries the greeting text indicating the location.
